article.hook: Ideas pile up faster than you can track. Conversations spin off into new questions before the last ones have answers. Jupiter in Gemini stretches our minds wide, turning curiosity into momentum.
article.lived: Over the next year or so, you’ll find days where you start reading one article and end up chasing five related threads - each promising a new connection or insight. Meetings and messages multiply, not just in number but in unexpected directions. Growth feels like juggling live wires: every new fact or voice sparks something else, expanding what you know and who you know all at once.
article.turn: The risk is scattering your attention until nothing sticks. When every new idea demands your energy, priorities blur and follow-through slips away. It’s easy to sound interested without actually landing anywhere meaningful. Focus doesn’t come from more options - it comes from choosing which ones deserve the weight of your time.
moves: Schedule one conversation this week that dives past small talk and into something you don’t already know.
Turn off notifications for an hour to finish one idea start before jumping to the next.
Write a quick summary after meetings to capture what matters before the next distraction arrives.
